prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Sync & Protect Your Desktop Companion", "Use your primary account to automatically save your pet's memory, custom traits, and progression across installs.", "Cloud Restore Protection Enabled", "Continue with Google"]
1: ["Finalizing Desktop Companion Launch", "Check your system tray if companion does not appear immediately."]
2: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Your pet is active on your desktop. Right-click for options, drag to move around, or use hotkeys to interact.", "Quick Desktop Controls Overview"]
3: ["Name & Adopt Your New Companion", "Officially register your pet's name first before customizing their visual look."]
4: ["Choose Your Onboarding Speed", "Select Instant Adopt (30-sec setup with ready presets) or Custom Creator (2-min personalized traits).", "You can create extra pets or modify traits at any time later in app settings."]
5: ["Returning user? Sign in with your original email account to instantly retrieve your previously adopted pets."]
6: ["Select Companion & Unlock Starter Accessory", "Adopt your desktop pet now to claim your bonus starter accessory.", "Bonus: Exclusive Starter Accessory Unlocked"]
7: ["Preparing Desktop Pet Workspace", "Initializing desktop overlay rendering, audio engine, and system tray quick controls..."]
8: ["Your Companion Has Arrived!", "Look at your desktop! Your pet is active and waiting near your taskbar.", "Click the taskbar icon anytime to pin or hide your companion.", "Start Playing"]
9: ["Explore Desktop Companion Options", "Live Companion Motion Preview"]

verdicts.problem: Promises bonus gifts and free extras
